The Studio

Curating Spatial Silence

An architectural practice dedicated to residential and commercial environments of enduring presence.

Our Vision

Crafting Spaces That Stand Outside of Time.

Founded on the belief that interior environments profoundly influence human experience, Ace New Interior designs spaces stripped of artificial ornamentation.

Our team collaborates with master artisans, structural engineers, and landscape architects across Kyoto, London, and New York to deliver commissions that age with timeless distinction.

Core Principles

01

Restraint & Reduction

We remove noise until only purpose and beauty remain. True architecture does not shout; it holds space for clarity.

02

Tactile Truth

Every stone, timber plane, and bronze detail is chosen for its structural honesty and how it acquires character over decades.

03

Light & Atmosphere

Sunlight and shadow dictate spatial rhythm. We design volumes around natural illumination to shape serenity.
